title: Mere Bhai Abbas
body:
Sheh Kamar Thaam Ke Bole Mere Bhai Abbas
Mere Bhai Abbas
<<DIVIDER>>
Gurz Jab Aake Laga Sar Pe Jari Ke Bhaari,
Boli Zainab Ke Mere Bhai Main Tumpe Waari,
Aankh Se Shah Ki Hone Lage Aansoo Jaari,
Kuch Qadam Chalne Mein Jab Hone Lagi Dushwaari,
<<DIVIDER>>
Sheh Kamar Thaam Ke Bole Mere Bhai Abbas,
Humko Manzoor Nahi Teri Judaayi Abbas.
<<DIVIDER>>
Chhod Kar Ahle Haram Ko Main Yahan Aaya Hoon,
Teri Nusrat Ko Akela Main Kahan Aaya Hoon,
Hai Yahan Khuld Se Maa Fatema Aayi Abbas.
<<DIVIDER>>
Sheh Kamar Thaam Ke Bole Mere Bhai Abbas,
Humko Manzoor Nahi Teri Judaayi Abbas.
<<DIVIDER>>
Teri Ghurbat Pe Rulaate The, Laeen Hanste The,
Do Kate Baazu Dikhate The, Laeen Hanste The,
Ye Jafa Mujh Pe Laeenon Ne Hai Dhaayi Abbas.
<<DIVIDER>>
Sheh Kamar Thaam Ke Bole Mere Bhai Abbas,
Humko Manzoor Nahi Teri Judaayi Abbas.
<<DIVIDER>>
Mujhko Ek Mashq Mili Thi Jo Bahut Zakhmi Thi,
Teri Furqat Mein Wo Asgar Ki Tarah Roti Thi,
Maine Wo Mashq Thi Seene Se Lagaayi Abbas.
<<DIVIDER>>
Sheh Kamar Thaam Ke Bole Mere Bhai Abbas,
Humko Manzoor Nahi Teri Judaayi Abbas.
<<DIVIDER>>
Ek Din Dekha Tha Siffin Mein Hamla Tera,
Kya Ajab Shaan Wo Teri Thi, Magar Ae Bhaiya,
Aaj Hai Surkh Tere Khoon Se Taraayi Abbas.
<<DIVIDER>>
Sheh Kamar Thaam Ke Bole Mere Bhai Abbas,
Humko Manzoor Nahi Teri Judaayi Abbas.
<<DIVIDER>>
Aao Khaime Ki Taraf Chalte Hain Bhai Mere,
Muntazir Meri Sakina Hai Tumhari Kab Se,
Dar-e-Khaima Se Wo Deti Hai Duhaayi Abbas.
<<DIVIDER>>
Sheh Kamar Thaam Ke Bole Mere Bhai Abbas,
Humko Manzoor Nahi Teri Judaayi Abbas.
<<DIVIDER>>
Har Payambar Ki Wafa Takti Hai Hairaani Se,
Haath Katwa Diye Jo Ho Gaye Tar Paani Se,
Tumne Kya Khoob Wafaadaari Nibhaayi Abbas.
<<DIVIDER>>
Sheh Kamar Thaam Ke Bole Mere Bhai Abbas,
Humko Manzoor Nahi Teri Judaayi Abbas.
<<DIVIDER>>
Barsare Karbobala Khoon Rulaaya Tumko,
Munh Ke Bal Ghode Se Be-Dast Giraaya Tumko,
Be-Rukhi Kaisi Ye Ummat Ne Dikhaayi Abbas.
<<DIVIDER>>
Sheh Kamar Thaam Ke Bole Mere Bhai Abbas,
Humko Manzoor Nahi Teri Judaayi Abbas.
<<DIVIDER>>
Us Ghadi Faiz Sar-e-Arsh Bapa Tha Mehshar,
Bola Shabbir Se Jis Waqt Ye Sher-e-Haider,
Ek Bhai Se Juda Hota Hai Bhai Abbas.
<<DIVIDER>>
Sheh Kamar Thaam Ke Bole Mere Bhai Abbas,
Humko Manzoor Nahi Teri Judaayi Abbas.
author: Faiz Kanodari
